videos.title: Iran issues demands to reopen Hormuz. Trump says it's US territory
videos.author: CNN

analysis.summary: The transcript covers the expiration of a U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding with no nuclear deal, Iran's new demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and President Trump's social media post labeling the strait as 'new U.S. territory.' Maritime traffic through the strait remains severely restricted after another ship was struck. Analysts note growing Gulf skepticism about U.S. security guarantees and suggest a regional framework, possibly involving Oman as intermediary, may be needed to resolve the standoff. Trump's approval stands at 33% with gas prices at highs ahead of midterm elections.

Kushner credits mediators including Egypt, Qatar, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE for applying pressure, and highlights that the UAE has been the biggest donor to Gaza, helping the Palestinian people through the framework of the Abraham Accords. He discusses plans for Gaza reconstruction contingent on demilitarization, notes improved aid delivery and reduced malnutrition, and addresses ongoing back-channel negotiations with Iran despite the expiration of a memorandum of understanding.
